prompt:
Create an original art-direction comparison sheet for the existing native mobile game Starfall. Use the first reference (actual gameplay screenshot) for its moonlit lavender terrace, illustrated celestial observatory atmosphere, crystalline aqua star material, family-color light, and centered announcement position. Use the second reference (historical branding review) only for the established warmth, approachable chunky/rounded silhouettes and pearl lettering direction. The new task is expressive custom gameplay celebration lettering, not a new logo, background or game UI. All rendered design content is a CONCEPT, not a screenshot of working code.

Produce a beautifully composed LANDSCAPE comparison board with THREE equally sized vertical panels on deep midnight blue. Quiet small editorial labels at top: "A · STARLIGHT PEARL", "B · CRYSTAL BURST", "C · COMET SWEEP". Add one small footer "LETTERING CONCEPTS — NOT IN-GAME CAPTURES".

Within EACH panel:
- Large original hand-designed hero word exactly "Brilliant!" in amber/pearl, showing that panel's lettering treatment on clean midnight. Make these visibly custom display letterforms, not standard rounded UI type with a glow slapped on.
- Below, a medium original word exactly "Constellation!" using the same treatment in AQUA with pearl highlights, on a restrained crop inspired by the reference's lavender terrace surface. Beneath it the exact award "+5" in large companion numerals. This lower portion demonstrates readability at realistic mobile scale. Do not reproduce phone chrome, dialogue, game controls, cast or score header. Keep the backdrop crop nearly identical among the three panels; typography is the comparison.
- Keep letter counters open and readable, silhouettes strong, no decorative panel or ribbon behind the words. Lettering can have a gentle arch or lively rhythm but must read instantly. Small sparkle accents can complement the word; never replace a letter or numeral with a star.

A STARLIGHT PEARL: sculpted, hand-lettered storybook display type with warm personality. Broad plush strokes, distinct tapered/flared terminals, gently uneven joyful proportions and an intentional silhouette. Pearl-white luminous top faces, jewel-family aqua/amber bevel rims, shallow violet offset depth, one or two crisp star gleams. Softly carved glass/pearl, not inflated toy balloons, no plastic candy. This is the lead direction: belongs to friendly expressive crystal characters and a magical celestial sanctuary.

B CRYSTAL BURST: visibly different original carved crystal lettering. Bold and slightly angular but friendly, large smooth facets, broad readable bowls, bright pearl faces and aqua/amber translucent edge planes, amethyst depth and a sharp luminous rim. Energetic modest rising arc, crystalline impact; not heavy metal, medieval RPG, spiky runes or shattered illegible glass.

C COMET SWEEP: original expressive, slightly right-leaning hand-lettered display, strong sweeping rhythm, broad confident strokes with tapered comet-like terminals and short graceful trailing swashes. Pearl interiors, aqua/amber illuminated edges, a single restrained orbital sweep under the hero word. Not delicate cursive; every letter must be instantly identifiable. Dynamic and celestial, not sports/esports graffiti.

The three treatments must have meaningfully DIFFERENT letter skeletons, not just different lighting. Art-directed, polished game typography, charming and dramatic. Retain the reference palette: moonlit pearl, midnight/plum depth, lavender, family aqua and warm amber. Do not introduce red casino text, comic-book explosion clouds, crowns, badges, logos, coins, multiplier marks, extra copy or extra UI. Exact spelling and punctuation throughout. No full-screen bloom obscuring letters. Plenty of breathing room. Make the words visually dominant and easy to compare.
